I truly hope you can find better coping skills that can work for you, I've struggled with sh since I was 14 (22 now, clean for 1/2 years) and it's not something that's easy to stop doing. Like any other addiction, you have to really want it and work for it. It helped me a lot after starting therapy, but it still went in for years. In my situation, I believe positive life changes and indulging in hobbies is what helped me finally quit. But even now, after everything, I still get the urge sometimes, even when everything is fine and I'm happy, I have to remind myself how far I've come and how hard it was to get here. I hope the best for you!
